name: elpis-editor
description: Chat with your Elpis runtime using live VS Code documents and language intelligence.

elpis.followupBehavior.description: Queue follow-ups until the current turn completes or steer its active turn. Ctrl+Enter chooses the opposite behavior when Enter is the send shortcut.

elpis.showContextUsage.description: Show the runtime's last reported context-window usage in the composer.

elpis.accountSource.description: Use the Elpis login or the ChatGPT login saved by Codex. Elpis configuration and history stay in Elpis home. Reconnect after changing this setting.

elpis.executable.description: Standalone app-server built from Elpis (not the elpis TUI or upstream Codex). Existing Elpis authentication/configuration is used.

elpis.home.description: Optional Elpis state/configuration directory. Empty uses ELPIS_HOME or ~/.elpis, matching the Elpis TUI. Inherited CODEX_HOME is not used.

elpis.provider.description: Inference provider. Empty uses existing Elpis configuration.

elpis.model.description: Optional model override; empty retains the Elpis configured model.

elpis.reasoningEffort.description: Reasoning effort selected from the current model's runtime capabilities; empty uses the configured default.

elpis.sendShortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut for sending a chat message. Shift+Enter always inserts a new line.

elpis.editorAccess.description: Permit this window's Elpis bridge to read live editor buffers and use language providers. Disabling immediately blocks editor tools; start a new conversation to remove previously seen facts.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out elpis-editor-0.1.0.vsix
scripts.test: node --test test/rpc.test.js test/provider-catalog.test.js test/approvals.test.js test/model-repair.test.js test/settings.test.js test/account-source.test.js test/approval-modes.test.js test/history-controls.test.js test/followups.test.js test/inline-approval.test.js test/ide-context.test.js test/smart-pruning.test.js test/startup.test.js
